The rider's felt overcharge is a time effect: 22.0 min against a 16.3 min estimate (+5.7 min) [F2], which on a metered taxi is chargeable time, not a routing defect [F2][F5][RD-2].

The driver's account is consistent with the records: he states he followed the app route exactly in rain and slow traffic [F7], and the system records show no deviation [F1][F3] plus band 3 (20–29 km/h) on the Pan Island Expressway and Airport Boulevard during 17:09–17:47 under 18.5 mm of heavy rain [F8][F9][F11]. No in-app chat exists at all, so no rider consent message under RD-5 is available and none is needed [F6][RD-5].

Account action: RD-6 requires an upheld violation this case (refund > 0 or recorded RD-1 breach) plus an upheld route dispute in the prior 90 days. The rider has 0 disputes and 0 upheld, and the driver has 0 upheld route disputes over 1163 trips in 90 days [F12][F13], so the precondition is unmet and no flag_account follows [F12][F13][RD-6]. Amount is $0.00 and no refund line is computable.
